verdict.rationale: The architecture docs say the control plane stays out of the data path and by default does not see LLM traffic, which limits Kong's own exposure to user data. DLP policies can also strip personally identifiable information before prompts reach upstream providers. Neither is an explicit protection against model training, so this is indirect, partial support. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data-use policy or commitment from Kong, a mechanism to enforce provider-side training opt-outs or zero-retention, and independent corroboration.
